questions.name: newlines
questions.question: Why should CSV files be opened with newline="" when reading and writing?
semantic_facts: Without it embedded quoted newlines may be misread; CRLF-writing platforms can add an extra carriage return.
questions.citation_requirement: Every claim needs exact entailing frozen spans.

questions.name: row_shape
questions.question: How does csv.DictReader handle extra or missing fields by default, and can csv.writer preserve a distinction between None and an empty string?
semantic_facts: Extra fields form a list under restkey, default None.
Missing fields use restval, default None.
writer writes None as empty string, losing that distinction.
